info.title: DocReader PoC API
info.description:
Local proof of concept for document ingestion, OCR, classification and extraction.

**There is no authentication.** Every endpoint is anonymous, the Swagger page is public and
no bearer token is required. Do not expose this API to the internet and do not send real
personal documents to it. Use synthetic, masked or authorized files only.

Conventions: JSON in camelCase, timestamps in UTC ISO 8601, errors as
`application/problem+json`, and an `X-Correlation-Id` header on every response.

Stage 3 of the execution plan delivers upload, listing, detail, content, deletion, OCR
(PP-OCRv5 on CPU, see ADR 0002), the raw text and the structured result of seven document
types: CPF card, CIN/RG, CNH, proof of address, CNPJ card, CCMEI and social contract.
Other document types are read as raw text only.

post.summary: Receives a document and queues it for processing.
post.description:
The response is asynchronous on purpose: the API stores the original, issues the protocol and
answers `202 Accepted` with a `Location` header, while OCR, classification and
extraction run in the worker. Poll `statusUrl` to follow the document.
            
Accepted formats are PDF, PNG, JPEG and TIFF, checked by the real file signature rather than
by the announced content type. Size and page limits are configurable and answer 413 and 422.
            
Send the optional `Idempotency-Key` header to make a retry safe: the same key with the
same file replays the original response, and the same key with a different file answers 409.

parameters.name: X-Upload-Channel
parameters.description:
Origin of the upload, `WEB` or `API`. The interface sends WEB; anything else
defaults to API.

File.description:
The document itself. PDF, PNG, JPEG or TIFF, validated by its real signature and not by the
announced content type.

ExpectedDocumentType.description:
Optional hint about the document type. It never overrides the classifier; a divergence is
recorded instead.

ExternalReference.description: Optional reference of the calling system, echoed back in every response.

ProductServiceCode.description: Code of the product or service the document is for. Unknown or inactive codes answer 422.

get.description:
Every filter is optional and they combine with AND. `page` starts at 1 and
`pageSize` is capped by the configured maximum. The envelope carries
`totalCount` and `totalPages` so a client can paginate without guessing.

interpreted. It belongs to the latest extraction: while a reprocessing runs, the previous text
stays available and `status` tells what is happening now. Answers 409 while there is
nothing to return yet, or when every attempt failed.

get.summary: Explains how the document was classified, for debugging a document that came out UNKNOWN.
get.description:
Runs the classifier again, with the rules in force now, over the text of the latest extraction. For
every document type it tried, it reports the score, the threshold, each evidence found or missing
(with the rule pattern that matched and whether OCR errors had to be tolerated) and a sentence
saying why the type was or was not accepted. `recorded` is what was stored when the document
was processed; it differs from `current` after the rules changed, until the document is
reprocessed. Nothing is written. The raw text is included by default because it is the first thing
to look at; it is the same content as `/text`, and `includeText=false` leaves it out.
Answers 409 while there is nothing to return yet, or when every attempt failed.

parameters.name: includeText
parameters.description: Whether to include the raw OCR text. Defaults to true.

get.summary: Explains how the fields of a document were extracted, for debugging a field that came out empty or wrong.
get.description:
Runs the extraction again, with the rules in force now, over the OCR blocks stored with the latest
extraction. It returns the blocks with their coordinates (`pages`), the coverage (how many fields
were read) and, for every field, its status, the reason (`LABEL_NOT_FOUND`, `VALUE_EMPTY`,
`VALUE_REJECTED`, `VALIDATION_FAILED` and so on), a sentence explaining it, and what its rule
searched: the labels tried, the lines they were found on and the candidate values examined.
`recordedStatus` is what was stored when the document was processed; it differs from `status`
after the rules changed, until the document is reprocessed. Nothing is written. The OCR text, the values
read and the candidate texts are included by default, the same content as `/text` and `/result`;
`includeText=false` leaves them out and keeps the statuses, reasons and line numbers. An extraction
stored before blocks were kept has no coordinates (`ocrInput` is `PAGE_TEXT`): reprocess it.
Answers 409 while there is nothing to return yet, or when every attempt failed.

parameters.name: includeText
parameters.description: Whether to include the OCR text and the values read. Defaults to true.

get.description:
Each field carries the value as read (`raw`), the normalized value, a confidence between
0 and 1, a validation status (`VALID`, `INVALID`, `NOT_FOUND` or
`UNCERTAIN`) with machine readable messages such as `CHECK_DIGIT_VALID`, and the
evidence (page and bounding box in pixels of the analysed page image). A field that was not
found is null, never invented. Answers 409 while there is nothing to return yet, or when
every attempt failed.

post.summary: Creates a retention policy for a document type, a product or service, or both.
post.description:
Precedence, most specific first: type and product together, then the product alone, then the type alone,
then the global policy (both omitted), which always exists. There is one policy per scope.
Creating or changing a policy does not recalculate the purge date of documents that already have one:
they pick it up when reprocessed.

score.description: Evidence found minus counter-evidence, between 0 and 1.

threshold.description: Score needed to accept the type.

accepted.description: Whether the score reached the threshold.

reason.description: Why the score is what it is.

evidence.description: Every evidence of the type, found or not.

counterEvidence.description: Every counter-evidence of the type, found or not.

documentType.description: The decision, UNKNOWN when no type reached its threshold.

confidence.description: Score of the chosen type; null when UNKNOWN.

minimumScoreOverride.description: Global minimum score in force, null when each type uses its own threshold.

textLength.description: Letters and digits the matcher worked with.

candidates.description: Every document type tried, best score first.

pages.description: Raw OCR text, page by page. Omitted with `includeText=false`.

ClassificationDiagnosticsResponse.description:
Why a document was classified as it was: the classification recorded at processing time, the same
decision recomputed with the rules in force now, every document type that was tried with its score and
evidence, and the raw text of the latest extraction.

current.reason: BR_CIN chosen with score 0.85 (threshold 0.60), best of 7 types tried.

candidates.reason: Score 0.85 reached the threshold 0.60. Found: title, republic, registration-number, birth-date, parentage, issue-date.

pages.text:
REPUBLICA FEDERATIVA DO BRASIL
REGISTRO DE IDENTIDADE CIVIL
DATA DE NASC / DATE OF BIRTH
FILUACAO

weight.description: Points added, or removed for counter-evidence.

matched.description: Whether it was found in the text.

matchedPattern.description: Rule pattern that matched; not document content.

matchKind.description: EXACT, or FUZZY when OCR errors were tolerated.

edits.description: Errors tolerated for a FUZZY match.

code.description: Unique code: 1 to 64 letters, digits, dots, hyphens or underscores, starting with a letter or digit. Stored in upper case and immutable.

storageRepositoryId.description: Repository the documents of this product are stored in; omit to use the default repository. Must exist and be active.

documentType.description: Document type the policy covers (BR_CPF_CARD, BR_CIN, BR_CNH, BR_PROOF_OF_ADDRESS, BR_CNPJ_CARD, BR_CCMEI or BR_SOCIAL_CONTRACT); omit for any type.

productServiceId.description: Id of the product or service the policy covers; omit for any.

retentionDays.description: Days a document is kept, from 1 to 36500.

code.description: Unique code: 1 to 64 letters, digits, dots, hyphens or underscores. Stored in upper case and immutable.

connectionConfig.description:
Provider settings, a flat object of strings, encrypted before it is stored. FILE_SYSTEM takes an optional
`directory` (relative to the storage root); DATABASE takes none; AZURE_BLOB_STORAGE needs
`connectionString` and `container`; AWS_S3 needs `bucket`, `accessKeyId` and
`secretAccessKey` and takes `region` and `serviceUrl`.

isDefault.description: Makes this the default repository; the previous default stops being one. Not allowed for a provider that is not implemented, or inactive.

url.description: Absolute http or https URL, with no credentials in it. Private, loopback and link-local addresses are refused unless the deployment allows them.

secret.description: The HMAC-SHA256 key, 16 to 256 characters. Leave it out to have one generated; it is then returned once, in this answer.

productServiceId.description: Only notify documents of this product or service; omit for every document.

index.description: Reading-order position; the one labels and candidates refer to.

boundingBox.description: Polygon as flat x/y pairs, in pixels of the analysed page image.

lineIndex.description: Block index the candidate came from.

penalty.description: Confidence discount for the distance from the label.

accepted.description: Whether the value read came from this candidate.

path.description: Field path in the schema of the type.

status.description: VALID, INVALID, NOT_FOUND or UNCERTAIN, with the rules in force now.

reason.description: FOUND, FOUND_WITHOUT_LABEL, LABEL_NOT_FOUND, VALUE_EMPTY, VALUE_REJECTED, VALIDATION_FAILED, VALUE_UNCERTAIN or PATTERN_NOT_FOUND.

boundingBox.description: Flat x/y pairs, in pixels of the analysed page image.

recordedStatus.description: Status stored when the document was processed; differs from `status` after a rule change, until reprocessing.

label.description: Label searched, normalized without accents and in upper case.

blocks.description: Blocks of the page, in reading order.

labels.description: Labels searched, each with the lines it was found on (empty when it was not found).

candidatesSeen.description: How many candidate values the rule examined.

DocumentDetailResponse.description:
Consolidated view of a document. Classification and extraction stay null until the worker has
produced them; the original file is always available regardless.

message.description: Short operator facing description, never document content.

ocrModelVersion.description: Pipeline and library versions, for reproducibility.

schemaVersion.description: Version of the schema used for the fields; null when the type has no extractor.

extractedAt.description: Instant the result was persisted, in UTC.

text.description: Raw OCR text, page by page.

reprocess.description: POST here to run the pipeline again.

DocumentLinks.description: Endpoints related to one document, so a client never has to build paths by hand.

attempt.description: Attempt in course or the last one that ran; 0 before the first is acquired.

maxAttempts.description: Attempts allowed before a transient failure becomes definitive.

pagesCompleted.description: Pages already read in the current attempt.

pageCount.description: Pages the attempt has to read, known once the worker starts.

nextAttemptAt.description: Earliest moment of the next attempt, in UTC, while a retry is scheduled.

DocumentProcessingResponse.description:
Where the asynchronous work of a document stands: which attempt, how many pages were read and,
when a retry is scheduled, when it will run. It is what makes a long document look alive instead
of stuck.

confidence.description: Confidence between 0 and 1; null when UNKNOWN.

extractorVersion.description: Version of the extraction rules; null when the type has no extractor.

schemaVersion.description: Version of the schema of the fields; null when the type has no extractor.

extractedAt.description: Instant the result was persisted, in UTC.

fields.description: Fields by name; empty when the document type has no extractor.

DocumentResultResponse.description:
Canonical result of PRD section 15: what was received, what the document was identified as and
the fields read from it, each with its raw and normalized value, confidence, validation status
and evidence.

fileName.description: Original file name as sent by the client.

externalReference.description: Caller reference sent at upload time.

expiresAt.description: When the document becomes eligible for purge, in UTC.

retentionDays.description: Days of retention in force when the date was set.

purgedAt.description: When the original file was removed; null while the document is alive.

DocumentRetentionResponse.description: The purge date of a document and where it came from.

DocumentStatus.description: Lifecycle of a document, as defined by RF-007 of the PRD.

detectedDocumentType.description: Type identified by the classifier, when available.

DocumentStatusResponse.description: Lightweight payload for polling, cheap enough to be called every couple of seconds.

fileName.description: Original file name as sent by the client.

mimeType.description: MIME type detected from the file signature.

expectedDocumentType.description: Type hint sent at upload time, when any.

detectedDocumentType.description: Type identified by the classifier, null until the document is classified.

externalReference.description: Caller reference sent at upload time, when any.

expiresAt.description: When the document becomes eligible for purge, in UTC; null when no retention was applied.

items.description: Items of the current page, newest first.

totalCount.description: Total number of items matching the filters.

totalPages.description: Number of pages for the current page size.

text.description: Text of the page, one recognized line per line.

extractedAt.description: Instant the text was persisted, in UTC.

DocumentTextResponse.description: The raw text the OCR read, page by page, in reading order. Nothing was interpreted or corrected.

pages.text:

eventType.description: Event name, for example RECEIVED or QUEUED.

fileName.description: Original file name as sent by the client.

externalReference.description: Caller reference sent at upload time.

expectedDocumentType.description: Type hint sent at upload time.

mimeType.description: MIME type detected from the file signature.

raw.description: Value exactly as read from the document.

normalized.description: Normalized value; null when the field was not found or did not validate.

validationMessages.description: Machine readable codes that explain the status, such as CHECK_DIGIT_VALID.

expected.description: Fields of the type, not counting dynamic ones such as contract partners.

extracted.description: Fields read, valid or not: any status other than NOT_FOUND.

extractedAt.description: Instant the OCR of the latest extraction was persisted, in UTC.

recordedExtractorVersion.description: Extractor version stored with the latest extraction.

documentType.description: Type whose extractor ran; null when the document is UNKNOWN.

documentTypeSource.description: RECORDED, or CURRENT_CLASSIFICATION when the recorded type was UNKNOWN and today's rules recognise one.

ocrInput.description: BLOCKS (with coordinates) or PAGE_TEXT (an older extraction: plain lines, no geometry).

note.description: A warning about this diagnosis, when there is one.

fields.description: One entry per field of the type.

pages.description: The OCR blocks with coordinates, page by page. Omitted with `includeText=false`.

ExtractionDiagnosticsResponse.description:
Why the fields of a document came out as they did: the OCR blocks with coordinates as the extractor received
them, and for every field what the extraction rules in force now read, the reason it failed and what its rule
searched. Compare `status` with `recordedStatus` to see a result made stale by a rule change.

fields.explanation: The label was found on line 22, but no value was next to it, to its right or below it.

page.description: One based page of the evidence; null when the field was not found.

boundingBox.description: Flat x/y pairs of the text polygon, in pixels of the analysed page image.

ProductServiceReferenceResponse.description: The product or service a document is linked to.

code.description: Unique code, in upper case. Send it as `productServiceCode` when uploading.

active.description: An inactive product keeps its documents but refuses new uploads.

ProductServiceResponse.description: A product or service documents can be linked to.

items.description: Items of the current page, newest first.

totalCount.description: Total number of items matching the filters.

totalPages.description: Number of pages for the current page size.

detectedType.description: Type stored with the document; UNKNOWN or null when none was found.

classifierVersion.description: Rules version of the latest extraction.

documentType.description: Document type it covers, or null.

productServiceCode.description: Code of the product or service it covers, or null.

retentionDays.description: Days the policy says now; can differ from the days that set the date if it was edited since.

RetentionPolicyReferenceResponse.description: The policy that defined the purge date of a document.

documentType.description: Document type the policy covers, or null for any type.

retentionDays.description: Days a document is kept, counted from its upload (or from its last reprocessing).

isGlobal.description: The global policy always exists, covers whatever no other policy covers, and cannot be deleted.

RetentionPolicyResponse.description: How long documents are kept before they are purged, for one scope.

items.description: Items of the current page, newest first.

totalCount.description: Total number of items matching the filters.

totalPages.description: Number of pages for the current page size.

RetentionScope.description: What a retention policy applies to, from the most general to the most specific.

StorageProvider.description: Where the bytes of a document are kept.

StorageRepositoryReferenceResponse.description: The storage repository a product or service stores its documents in.

isDefault.description: Exactly one repository is the default; it stores the documents of every product that names none.

active.description: An inactive repository keeps serving its documents but takes no new ones.

hasConnectionConfig.description: Whether connection settings are stored. Their content is never shown.

isImplemented.description: False for the providers that are registered but whose adapter does not exist yet (AZURE_BLOB_STORAGE, AWS_S3): uploading to them answers 501.

StorageRepositoryResponse.description: A place documents are stored. The connection settings are secrets and are never returned.

items.description: Items of the current page, newest first.

totalCount.description: Total number of items matching the filters.

totalPages.description: Number of pages for the current page size.

storageRepositoryId.description: Repository the documents of this product are stored in; omit (null) to use the default repository. Must exist and be active.

retentionDays.description: Days a document is kept, from 1 to 36500. The scope of a policy cannot change.

isDefault.description: true makes this the default (the previous one stops being it); omit to leave it as is. false is refused for the current default.

connectionConfig.description:
Partial update of the settings: a key with a string sets it, a key with `null` removes it, the keys not sent
stay as they are. Omit the whole object to leave the settings alone.

url.description: Absolute http or https URL, with no credentials in it.

secret.description: A new signing secret, 16 to 256 characters. Omit it to keep the current one; there is no way to read the current one.

events.description: One or more of `document.completed`, `document.failed`, `document.purged`. Replaces the current list.

productServiceId.description: Only notify documents of this product or service; omit (null) for every document.

contentUrl.description: Endpoint that serves the original file.

UploadAcceptedResponse.description:
Body of the 202 answered by the upload endpoint. The document is persisted and queued; the OCR
runs afterwards, outside the request.

UploadChannel.description: How the document entered the system.

id.description: Identity of the delivery; it is the `X-Webhook-Delivery` header, the same on every retry.

nextAttemptAt.description: When the next attempt is due (meaningful while PENDING).

lastStatusCode.description: HTTP status the subscriber answered with on the last attempt.

lastError.description: Why the last attempt failed: HTTP_503, TIMEOUT, CONNECTION_FAILED, BLOCKED_ADDRESS.

createdAt.description: When it was queued, in UTC.

completedAt.description: When it succeeded, failed for good or was dropped, in UTC.

WebhookDeliveryResponse.description: One notification and how its sending is going.

items.description: Items of the current page, newest first.

totalCount.description: Total number of items matching the filters.

totalPages.description: Number of pages for the current page size.

WebhookDeliveryStatus.description: Where a notification is on its way to a subscriber.

secret.description: The signing secret, only when none was sent in the request and one had to be generated. Save it now: it is stored encrypted and no endpoint returns it again. Null when you supplied your own.

WebhookSubscriptionCreatedResponse.description: The answer to creating a subscription: the subscription and, when the secret was generated, the secret itself, this once.

active.description: An inactive subscription receives nothing, and what was still queued for it is dropped.

WebhookSubscriptionResponse.description: A subscriber that is told when a document reaches a final state. The signing secret is never returned.

totalCount.description: Total number of items matching the filters.

tags.name: Documents
tags.description:
Ingestion and consultation of documents. Every endpoint is anonymous in this proof of concept:
there is no login, no bearer token and no tenant.

tags.name: ProductServices
tags.description: Registry of the products and services a document can be uploaded for.

tags.name: RetentionPolicies
tags.description: How long documents are kept. The most specific policy that applies to a document decides its purge date.

tags.name: StorageRepositories
tags.description:
Where documents are stored. A document is stored in the repository of its product or service, or in the default one,
and stays there.

tags.name: WebhookSubscriptions
tags.description: Subscribers that are told, with a signed POST, when a document is completed, fails or is purged.
